answer: A pre-written answer bank hence goes stale within one epoch, and reusing one text across 71 aliases trips the duplicate check at the vault gate. The pearl receipt proves which words were live for that identity, and the audit replays it against the seed. The challenge words rotate once mid-epoch from a trellis seed nobody controls, and the answer is judged against the words it was submitted under. Honest users pay that once, farms 16 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
